verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer guide lists first-party call-handling capabilities: User Call Handling, State-based Rules, Interaction Rules, and Call Handling Configurations. The plan page also lists auto attendant. Together these suggest time- or state-based routing, but the evidence is only a navigation-level mention and never explicitly describes business-hours schedules. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of business-hours schedules, distinct open/closed/holiday behaviors, per-number scoping, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
